name: Picture-in-picture facecam
summary: A small live window of the player's face placed above the main picture, so the viewer sees the action and the reaction together.
how: Set the face window at 18% to 25% of the frame width.
Place it at a corner with a 24px margin.
Add a 4px border and a 12px radius.
Keep the window clear of the game HUD.

origin.note: Game players add a webcam window to their capture of the screen, so that their reaction shows next to the game.

adoptions.via: Players overlay a webcam window on screen captures of games.
Live stream layouts keep the face window as a fixed slot.
